annotations.title: Daily Agent Signal — one archive day

description: [PAID — 0.04 USDC on Base via x402] Use this when you want one specific past date's full brief, for example to audit or backtest a single day. Not when you want the most recent stored edition (use signal_latest) or several consecutive days (signal_history, one flat price). Point-in-time purchase of ONE proprietary archive date's full Signal brief — cheaper than buying full history for backtesting or auditing a single curated day. Body { date: YYYY-MM-DD }; only stored dates exist (listed free in /health archive_dates), and an unstored date gets a free 404 with payment_taken false, before any payment. $0.04 USDC on Base, paid via x402 by the calling agent's own wallet. Call with no payment_header first to receive the payment requirements; your own wallet pays, never this server's.

date.description: Stored archive date to fetch, format YYYY-MM-DD (one of /health archive_dates). Required.

payment_header.description: Optional. Omit on your first call to receive the x402 payment challenge for free. After your own wallet/x402 client signs against that challenge, call this same tool again with the SAME business arguments plus this field set to the header your x402 client produced (typically { name: "PAYMENT-SIGNATURE", value: "<base64 payload>" }). This server never holds a wallet and never pays on your behalf.

name.description: HTTP header name to attach, e.g. PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

value.description: HTTP header value (the signed payment payload).
